messages:
Alice: Quick sync — putting together Q3 roadmap slice for Security & Compliance. Primary asks from customers: per-tenant HSM/KMS keys, 13-month immutable audit log retention, legal-hold export, and SOC2 evidence automation. Need to decide priorities + launch criteria. Thoughts? :wave:

Ben: From PM — high volume of customers asking for per-tenant keying (esp. payments fintech). Can we scope MVP as KMS integration (tenant keys) + SaaS HSM later? Need rough effort estimates.

Eva: Infra: HSM (VM/hardware HSM) introduces procurement + PCI scope. We can do KMS-backed envelope keys quicker (1-2 sprints), HSM will be 2-3 months with vendor onboarding (Thales/Luna), region availability constraints.

Carol: Runtime/telemetry: audit logging needs request and response hashes, model version, route and key-id. Also we need a retention flag in the log index:
```
log_entry = {
  "ts": <iso>,
  "tenant": <id>,
  "model": "redwood-vX",
  "key_id": "proj-1234",
  "response_hash": "sha256(...)",
  "retention_until": "2027-09-01"
}
```
We should keep minimal PII in logs, store payloads encrypted at rest.

Dave: Legal: 13-month retention is baseline for many customers but some regs need 7+ years. We must support retention overrides per-tenant and legal-hold where retention_until is ignored. Also audit export format needs a signed manifest for chain of custody.

Ben: Launch criteria proposal: 1) per-tenant KMS support (KMS key rotation tested), 2) audit log schema v1 implemented + 13mo retention default, 3) legal-hold API + export, 4) docs and SSO + RBAC for access, 5) e2e tests and a canary with two customers.

Alice: +1. Also need cost targets (per-token extra storage) — Redwood Optimize team to give estimate. Eva, can we get cost estimate for 13mo vs 3mo storage? :money_with_wings: 

Eva: Rough numbers: 13mo ~ 3x cost vs 90d because of cold storage and index growth. We'll run a query next week with sample workload and post numbers.

compliance-bot: SOC2 checklist updated — https://confluence.redwood/soc2/q3. New items: evidence export, immutable audit logs, key management proof.

Carol: Tradeoffs: rolling out KMS-only first means we can avoid HSM procurement but some enterprise customers will require HSM attestation. Suggest roadmap: Phase 1 KMS + audit v1, Phase 2 HSM + FIPS attestations + per-tenant HSM.

Ben: Can we make Phase 1 shippable as GA for mid-market, with a clear upgrade path for enterprise? We'll mark enterprise-only features and price appropriately.

Alice: Owners & next steps: Ben (product) -> finalize scope and customer segmentation by Tue, Eva (infra) -> cost + vendor feasibility by Wed, Carol (eng) -> schema + retention flag + privacy plan by Fri, Dave (legal) -> legal-hold API contract + export manifest spec by Fri. I'll consolidate into OKR ticket.

Ben: I'll also add a success metric: <90% support requests on retention/kms after GA for 90 days.

Alice: Cool. If no objections I'll put this into the Q3 roadmap doc and raise an RFC. :thumbsup: 

Carol: one more nit — for audit logs we should include model input/hash or just response? prefer input hash only to avoid storing raw inputs.

Dave: Agreed, store hashes only unless customer explicitly opts in with DPA.

Ben: noted. We'll schedule a customer scoping call for next Wed 10am PST. Invite sent.

Eva: posting preliminary cost numbers in thread after tests.

Alice: thanks everyone — tagging for visibility @here
